output.reason: [ev-d308231cd8ab] lists this under Feature. It describes a new, optional way to set JKS/PKCS12 keystore passwords as literal values, and the existing `passwordSecretRef` field stays in place. The mutual-exclusivity rule only applies to the new literal field, which existing Certificates cannot already have set. So an environment that does nothing sees nothing fail, get rejected or get ignored, and "none" (informational) is supported.
